title: Invite friends
description: Earn Agent credits when new users register and authenticate with Skland.
unavailable: Referral activity could not be loaded. Please try again.
paused: The referral campaign is currently closed
pausedDescription: New referrals and rewards are paused. Credits already received remain available.
joinTitle: Register and authenticate with Skland to complete the invitation
joinDescription: Create a website account through the invitation link, verify your email, then authenticate with Skland. The inviter receives {points} credits, up to {max} per inviter. Existing accounts do not qualify as new users.
eligibilityBody: A friend must register a new website account through an invitation link, verify their email, then authenticate with Skland. The inviter is fixed at registration and cannot be added or changed afterwards. Only the inviter receives credits. Each Skland identity can qualify once; linking it again does not earn another reward.
limitsTitle: How many credits can I earn?
limitsBody: Each eligible new user earns the inviter {points} permanent credits, for up to {count} users and {max} credits in total. Reopening the campaign does not reset this limit.
pauseTitle: What happens when the campaign closes?
pauseBody: New referrals and reward issuance are paused. Existing referral records are kept, and eligible pending rewards can continue when the campaign reopens. Credits already received remain available.
permanent: Rewards are added to your permanent credit balance
shareDescription: Copy your link and share it with friends who have not registered
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
qrDescription: Your inviter earns credits after a new friend registers and authenticates with Skland.
rewardTitle: A friend registers and authenticates with Skland
rewardDescription: Rewards arrive automatically after eligible authentication, up to {max} permanent credits in total.
empty: No referrals yet. Share your invitation link with a friend.
